d: Long, flowing mahogany-brown hair with straight bangs and a high side ponytail tied with a white ribbon and red streamers. Sharp, narrow electric-blue eyes with a focused expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender build wearing a grey button-down vest over a white shirt with a red tie, a red plaid pleated skirt, and a long black open-front coat with gold-trimmed hems and a blue interior lining. Black thigh-high stockings with gold buckle straps and black pointed heels with gold tips, holding two katanas with black sheaths.
